system.description:
Wondrous Item, Legendary (Requires Attunement)

While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you have Truesight with a range of 120 feet centered on the spell's sensor.

notes: activation: 10 minute is not an action-economy cost
save: a failure marks its creature (narrative)
"Create Sensor" is passive or triggered (narrative): not automated
